attributes.name: Jai Random Scans
attributes.description:
Scanlating manga that interests me. I upload depending on my mood and if I'm not playing any games.  
  
Did you know all the manga that I have done alone are up for grabs? Message your favourite scanlation group to take over! Or don't and wait until I'm bored. Message me for inquiries.  
  
My discord tag is Jai#3489  
if you have anything you want to ask.  
Current Status: Still Low HP

attributes.name: Schale scans
attributes.description:
Welcome to schale scans, i can't really think of a better description, 
but we like to scan mangas of all kinds, nothing is left behind
If you ever spot any issue, hit us up on the server and we'll fix it right away! 

and lastly commissions are available for doujins and manga at crazy cheap rates, 
so drop by on the server and reach out to me, sora.
